brick1991.method: DXF indexed CIRCLE anchors with independent PNG ring-center validation using the shared factory map affine projection
brick1991.note: Original DXF states locations are approximate present-day city/county/eup/myeon reference centers, not surveyed historical factory parcel addresses.

brick2026.method: DXF indexed CIRCLE anchors projected to PNG with linear x/y scale and offset; 10 separate PNG marker checks
brick2026.dataAccuracyCaveat: The DXF has exact, approx, and exact-ish location labels. These are geospatial provenance estimates, separate from pixel registration accuracy. One original name is shown in angle brackets.

tile2026.method: All 24 indexed pairs of DXF cross POLYLINE coordinates + separate reference matching to 22 visually distinct red PNG crosses; two adjacent crosses merge into one connected raster component.
tile2026.note: Coordinates reflect existing DXF map symbol registration, not independently surveyed factory parcel accuracy. Source states 2025.12 registration while graphic is labeled 2026.

tile1991.method: 1991 DXF labeled CIRCLE markers mapped to existing PNG with common calibrated DXF-to-raster affine transform; 22 independent isolated cement rings visually verified within 3.2 px of predicted raster center; 5 clay rings (~14px radius) accounted for.
tile1991.alignment: DXF circle center → map image pixel (x: 11.33123783*x - 32.26701469; y: -11.33819076*y + 97.75561102), normalized to 2382×3368.
tile1991.discrepancy: Cement marker number 022 occurs twice in DXF. The location associated with 서울 구로구 was used (DXF circle near 86.915,-119.577); unrelated extra 022 marker near 109.567,-126.161 excluded.
tile1991.caution: Original 1991 cooperative member listing is not a census of all operating factories and locations are historical/map approximations, not independently verified factory parcel coordinates.
